prompt_text: What is a good martial arts school for kids in St. Peters MO?
answer_verbatim:
A good place to start is **World Martial Arts Academy**, at **1057 Cave Springs Blvd.** It offers age-specific classes, including preschool (ages 4–5) and kids (6–10), and its site lists tuition at **$159/month with no long-term contract or cancellation fee**. It may be a good fit if you’re looking for a structured program focused on confidence, focus, and discipline. [Website](https://blackbeltstl.com/)

If your child is more interested in grappling and practical self-defense, consider **Revive Brazilian Jiu Jitsu**, at **1278 Jungermann Road**. It has a kids’ program and advertises a free trial class. [Website](https://www.revivebjj.com/)

I’d visit or try a class at both before committing. Ask about class size, instructor experience with your child’s age, how they handle rough play, and the full cost after any introductory offer.
